column1: # Status of each BEAST 2 example XML, for the status page (scripts/build_status_page.py).
# Columns: example (as in the README inventory) <TAB> tester <TAB> status <TAB> note.
# Notes may use `code`, **bold** and [links](url). Status is one of:
#   explained  flagged only because of a known, explained difference
#   open       needs a decision (conversion differs, or not converted)
#   blocked    needs a build with a fix made after rc2 (rc3)
#   none       no results in the repo yet
# Min ESS and max z come from the row for <example> (".json" -> "-json") in
# reports/summary/batch-summary.md; "Converted" and "Converted in" from the README inventory.
